title: Full-Q Gibbs cylinder functional and ordered-limit existence audit

exact_scope.carrier_family: Use exactly the PAH-OMC-004 two-row strip G_n for every integer n>=2 and no new carrier, subdivision, root or boundary repair.
exact_scope.finite_parameter_path: Use exactly the PAH-OMC-010 path K=2, M_s=M_psi=1, epsilon=1/2, beta=nu=1, m2=0 and all displayed couplings equal to one; R_max=R ranges over every positive integer.
exact_scope.full_q_state_space: Use exactly the PAH-OMC-012 graded union Omega_n^gr(R)=disjoint_union_Q {Q}xOmega_(rho_(n,R,Q),Q), with each component the unchanged PAH-001 finite fixed-Q configuration space.
exact_scope.finite_component_state: For every admitted finite component use only pi_(rho_(n,R,Q))(omega)=Z_(rho_(n,R,Q))^(-1) exp(-beta F_(rho_R)(omega)) with counting normalization, as declared by PAH-001.
exact_scope.common_cylinder_algebra: Use the unchanged grade-blind bounded gauge- and anchor-automorphism-invariant cylinder algebra generated by finitely many retained ell_v and closed-face holonomy characters; R-488 ell_a, ell_d, H_0 and H_1 remain included.
exact_scope.candidate_full_q_functional: A full-Q functional could have the form mu_(n,R)(f)=sum_Q w_(n,R,Q) sum_(omega in Omega_(rho_(n,R,Q),Q)) pi_(rho_(n,R,Q))(omega) f(Q,omega), but this audit does not instantiate w_(n,R,Q).
exact_scope.source_weight_law: ABSENT_IN_SOURCE: PAH-001 declares fixed-Q normalization and forbids cross-Q comparisons; PAH-OMC-012 explicitly records that no cross-Q mixing probabilities or global normalized Gibbs measure are supplied.
declared_limit_order: LOCAL_STATE_CUTOFF: (K,M_s,M_psi,R_max)->infinity at fixed finite complex, epsilon, a, beta and selector; topology to be specified; DECLARED_NOT_PROVED
LATTICE_REFINEMENT: a->0 along named anchor-preserving refinement at fixed physical-volume target; topology to be specified; DECLARED_NOT_PROVED
VOLUME_EXHAUSTION: |V| and nested anchored exhaustion -> infinity after lattice refinement; local cylinder topology to be completed; DECLARED_NOT_PROVED
PHASE_SELECTOR: j_phase->0 after volume/exhaustion; weak state topology to be specified; DECLARED_NOT_PROVED
APERTURE_COLLAPSE: epsilon->0 with gamma_I/epsilon_c->infinity and exterior parameters fixed; spectral-window/finite-time transfer topology; DECLARED_NOT_PROVED
GROUND_STATE: beta->infinity only if needed; weak state topology to be specified; DECLARED_NOT_PROVED
OBSERVATION_TIME: T_obs->infinity last; first-passage topology; DECLARED_NOT_PROVED
exact_scope.limit_order_firewall: Retain PAH-001 critical order: aperture collapse precedes observation time. This packet takes no limit and does not upgrade any declared-not-proved topology.
exact_scope.boundary_input: Retain the R-484 hidden-diagonal boundary defect exactly as 16/9; no averaging, cancellation or counterterm is permitted.
exact_scope.uniformity_input: Retain R-490 C_sw=540 only as a state-weighted domination input. It cannot define cross-Q sector weights or prove a cylinder-state limit.

target_tests.existence: Determine whether the declared sources supply any normalized nonnegative sector law that makes mu_(n,R) a defined functional on the common full-Q cylinder.
target_tests.identifiability: If a law is absent, report the surviving unspecified weight family rather than selecting a representative.
target_tests.stability: Require an explicit Cauchy error epsilon_(n,R)(f)->0 under the fixed PAH-001 order; no bound is asserted when mu_(n,R) is undefined.
target_tests.positivity_normalization: Check positivity and mu_(n,R)(1)=1 only after a source-owned sector law exists; the present packet records these checks as not testable.
target_tests.nonzero_observables: Retain R-488 nonzero component witnesses, but do not infer a nonzero global limit without sector weights.
target_tests.stationarity: Test omega(L f)=0 only after a common functional and a compatible domain are supplied; PAH-OMC-013 finite componentwise intertwining is reference-only here.

missing_assumptions: A source-authorized, hash-pinned nonnegative sector law w_(n,R,Q)>=0 for every finite n,R, normalized by sum_Q w_(n,R,Q)=1, or an equivalent projective full-Q probability law.
A declaration of whether the sector law is independent of beta, phase selector and external sources, as required by the fixed-source scope.
A common full-Q probability space or completed cylinder functional on which the component Gibbs states can be mixed without changing PAH-001.
A topology and explicit Cauchy error epsilon_(n,R)(f)->0 for every finite-support cylinder f in the declared PAH-001 order.
Uniform control of the retained R-484 boundary defect and the R-490 domination input in the chosen full-Q norm; neither 16/9 nor C_sw=540 supplies this by itself.
A common domain on which the stabilized PAH-OMC-013 generator can be tested against the eventual functional.
falsifiers_or_reopen_triggers: A source-authorized parent packet already contains a normalized cross-Q sector law that this audit failed to locate.
A source-owned law exists but is not positive or does not normalize on every finite graded union.
Two source-authorized constructions give inequivalent cylinder limits while both claim the same fixed order.
A claimed Cauchy estimate uses fitted weights, conditional averaging, C_sw as a probability, boundary averaging, or a changed PAH functional/rate.
non_claims: This is a researcher-owned finite source-scope audit, not an external source or physical authority.
HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE is not a universal no-go: it states only that the hash-pinned parent scope does not define the requested full-Q functional.
No infinite-volume Gibbs state, weak cylinder limit, closability, Markov semigroup, quantum real-time dynamics or ordered-limit theorem is claimed.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
Markov time remains external stochastic time and is not quantum real time, proper time or Lorentzian time.
R-488 component witnesses, R-484 defect 16/9 and R-490 C_sw=540 are not promoted to a global state or physical observable.
single_next_question: Can a source-authorized, hash-pinned nonnegative normalized family w_(n,R,Q) (or equivalent projective cross-Q law) be supplied with its topology and fixed PAH-001 limit order, without modifying PAH-001 or fitting weights?
revisit_condition: Reopen this gate only when that one source-owned sector law and its normalization/topology are present, or when an exact parent-scope counterexample to the absence audit is supplied.
